description: a gaunt undead king of the dead with grey-green skin, a skull-like face with glowing green eyes, a dark crown with two large black branching antlers, a high collar of pale bones and grey feathers on the shoulders, long dark grey and purple robes with glowing green runes, a belt of small skulls and bones, a long tattered dark cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, no green flames, no staff and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the antlers to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
